profile.headline: Software Engineering Manager | Full Stack Dev at Heart
profile.summary:
At my core, I’m a problem solver. When I see something that isn’t working, I can’t leave it alone — I need to understand it, improve it, and make it easier for the next person. Software development fits me because it’s exactly that: translating messy, human problems into systems that actually work.

I’m a Full Stack Software Engineer who’s been coding professionally since 2013. I’m deeply experienced on the front end, comfortable working across modern and legacy frameworks like Angular and React, and I bring the same methodical approach to back-end development in Node.js, Java, and Go. I’ve worked with both relational and non-relational databases, and I especially enjoy designing new systems — or evolving existing ones — that integrate cleanly with what’s already in place.

I’m not intimidated by new or unfamiliar technology. For me, the tools are just languages, and my job is to be a reliable translator between humans and computers, no matter which language is required.

I tend to show up as a team anchor. I’m comfortable taking on responsibility, pressure, and ambiguity when a team needs it, and I care a lot about clear communication. I make space for different communication styles, help surface the important things that need to be said out loud, and focus on figuring out the next right step.

Outside of my day-to-day work, I’m passionate about supporting new and aspiring developers. Through my alma mater and other organizations, I enjoy mentoring driven individuals and helping them navigate early career challenges.

I hold two bachelor’s degrees from the University of Georgia, spent time teaching English in Japan through the JET Programme, and completed both full stack web development and Java bootcamps at Georgia Tech. I’m proficient in Spanish and Japanese.

Outside of tech, I’ve volunteered with MomoCon, the largest anime and gaming convention in the Southeast, since 2017 and became Director of Productions in 2021. I’m also a published writer, and at one point moonlighted as an independent comic editor — proof that I’ve always been drawn to building and shaping things, whether they’re systems or stories.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Skills: Software Management · Software Infrastructure · Engineering Management · Software Solution Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer and technical owner for 4 production applications (front-end and back-end), delivering shared APIs and integrations used by internal teams and external OEM partners.

Architected and modernized systems using Angular (15 → 20+), TypeScript, Node.js / NestJS, and PostgreSQL on AWS Aurora, including re-platforming legacy on-prem services to AWS.

Designed and guided implementation of a login-less enrollment and document-signing flow, reducing dealership onboarding time by up to 50% with 60%+ customer adoption.

Re-architected client and role-based email templating, enabling scalable support for new notification types without duplicated logic; established shared user management now adopted by additional internal teams.

Increased back-end unit test coverage from 0% to 90%+ and implemented CI/CD enforcement (linting, coverage, automated tests), significantly improving deployment reliability and code quality.

Led  production operations including incident response, external integrations (SSO, webhooks/websockets, file feeds), AWS infrastructure (ECS, ECR, Step Functions, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager), and audit remediation, resolving all findings within two sprint cycles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core engineer contributing to front-end and back-end systems using Angular, TypeScript, and Go, supporting demo and pilot platforms that helped secure $2.5M+ in healthcare and manufacturing contracts.

Designed, implemented, and productionized dozens of customer-driven features across multiple services, collaborating directly with stakeholders in a fast, iterative environment.

Led QA and reliability efforts, managing domestic and near-shore contractors and introducing automated testing practices that increased QA throughput by 20%+.

Implemented Cypress-based end-to-end test suites across two applications and partnered with DevOps to establish a CI/CD pipeline with automated testing.

Owned and executed a Firestore → BigQuery data migration, ensuring data integrity while enabling scalable analytics and reporting.

Acted as technical lead for Agile process adoption, improving ticket quality, sprint planning accuracy, and delivery predictability across the engineering team.

Served as hiring manager for 6 contractor roles (front-end, back-end, QA, data), strengthening team capacity during rapid growth phases.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
Contract at The Home Depot

Full Stack Software Development Consultant specializing in React and Front End Development.

Quickly assimilated to and began developing alongside existing engineering team to create reusable component library for fortune 500 company utilizing React and Material UI.

Contributed dozens of new features to the in-house React component library, including robust documentation and thorough testing.

Brought test coverage of component library up to 90% for new and existing code using Jest and Jasmine.

Supported micro front end architecture by working with various implementation teams as a front end expert and managing integral structure.

Created documentation using Storybook to facilitate consistent front end architecture.

Collaborated with UX to produce a set of components which alleviate the burden on implementing teams, while allowing each team to meet business needs of large scale logistics operations.

Helped identify process improvements, leading to more structured sprints with clearer story point targets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Macy's Account as well as internal POC projects

Coordinated Agile workflow with local team and 3 additional teams in New York, San Francisco, and India.

Created documentation for new hires which reduced set-up time of the local environment from roughly one week to a single day.

Served as Tech Lead for a React Native POC with Firebase database demonstrating new features such as a shared shopping bag for ecommerce that would allow users to scan items in store and pay on their mobile device. This idea was pitched to the client and retained a white labeled POC within Cognizant.

Contributed to Java based POCs with microservice architecture using Spring/Spring Boot to create the project and Jenkins and PWS for deployment.

Assisted core team to begin transition of several small applications to Google Cloud from Heroku.
Participated with colleagues in the IBM Covid-19 Hackathon to create a MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) application to show COVID-19 data by state, with data pulled from an open source API, in a format that wouldn’t intimidate or confuse, including IBM Watson chat client to provide further information and additional customizable widgets such as a feed of uplifting social posts via Instagram API.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Coordinated upgrades and maintenance of web applications with React based front-end and Java back-end.

Trained over 100 clients to use beginner and advanced features of both web application and mobile application.

Created and Maintained documentation for internal and client usage of an e-learning application with over 25,000 active users.

Developed and Maintained all public-facing web applications using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Implemented use of SCSS to streamline per-client customization of web applications.

Cultivated client trust by providing reliable on-demand data reporting and high level technical support.

Oversaw roll out of new communication software to increase speed of communication between team members and reduce the risk of lost or late response both internally and externally, as well as a new time tracking solution which saved hundreds of dollars per employee per year.

positions.title: Assistant Language Teacher
positions.description:
Act as cultural ambassador to the local community.
Plan, organize, and facilitate special cultural activity classes.
Plan, prepare, and lead beginner level (elementary school) EFL classes with a Japanese instructor acting as support.
Consult with and prepare a Japanese instructor for beginner level EFL lesson plans.
Co-plan special intermediate culture classes with a Japanese instructor.
Assist a Japanese instructor in an Intermediate EFL classroom environment.
Provide native English content, voice recordings, and judgement of student assignments as well as course content.

positions.title: Private Home Tutor - English (ESL)
positions.description:
Gauge student ability in a one-on-one or sometimes small group (2-3) setting.
Design flexible custom lesson plan to address needs of the student at their current level.
Provide engaging, effective materials for in class use as well as self-study.
Provide appropriate but challenging reading materials for the student's level.
Discuss progress and goals with both students and parents.
Manage schedule of tutoring of up to 12 students per week.
Advise and guide students through formal schoolwork as necessary.

organizations.description: I lead the Production team. We assist with large scale event production including concerts, competitions, and high visibility events. I assist guests, attendees, and other volunteers to coordinator effort and fill gaps, ensuring smooth operation.

organizations.position: Assistant Director of Convention Operations · Oct 2017 - May 2021
